description: This header file declares cryptographic functions for setting a key, encrypting, and decrypting messages within the 'ead' service component of the project.

methods.name: ead_set_key
methods.description: Sets the cryptographic key used for encryption and decryption.

methods.name: ead_encrypt_message
methods.description: Encrypts a message represented by 'struct ead_msg' of given length.

methods.name: ead_decrypt_message
methods.description: Decrypts a message represented by 'struct ead_msg'.
